FlightsPage.title: Flight booking
FlightsPage.description: Tell us your trip details and our team will prepare the best options and fares.
FlightsPage.noResultsBody: We don't have a matching deal in our current selection — tell us your trip details and we'll prepare a quote.
FlightsPage.whatsappMessageWithQuery: Hello, I'm looking for a flight to {query}.

how.title: How your booking works
how.description: No automated search and no online payment — a booking agent handles your request from start to finish.

send.title: Send us your route
send.body: Fill in the two cities, your dates and how many are travelling. No account and no card required.

options.title: We put the options together
options.body: A booking agent reviews the available routings and fares, and sends you the comparison on WhatsApp.

issue.title: You confirm and we issue
issue.body: Once you pick the option that suits you, we complete the booking and send the ticket electronically.

cost.q: Is anything charged when I send the request?
cost.a: No. The form is a quote request only, and nothing is payable until you confirm the option you chose.

reply.a: A booking agent contacts you during working hours, on the WhatsApp number or phone you entered.

change.q: Can I change the details after sending?
change.a: Yes. Tell the agent on WhatsApp — there is no need to fill the form in again.

multicity.q: What about multi-city trips or group bookings?
multicity.a: Write the full routing in the notes field and the agent will build the quote around it.

FlightDetailPage.priceNote: Starting price per person for a return trip; it changes with the dates and availability at the time of booking.
FlightDetailPage.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to ask about the flight deal {route}.

HotelsPage.title: Hotel booking
HotelsPage.description: Choose your destination and dates, and we'll recommend a stay that fits your budget.

how.title: How your stay is booked
how.description: Prices shown on the site are indicative; the agent confirms the final price before anything is booked.

tell.title: Tell us city and dates
tell.body: Enter the destination, your check-in and check-out dates, and how many rooms and guests.

shortlist.title: We shortlist options
shortlist.body: We send you hotels within your budget, with photos, location and what the room includes.

confirm.title: You confirm and we send the voucher
confirm.body: Once you approve an option we complete the booking and send you the confirmation.

price.a: No — it is a starting price that changes with the dates, room type and availability. The agent confirms the final price before booking.

breakfast.a: It varies by hotel and room type, and is stated in the offer we send you.

rooms.q: Can I book more than one room?
rooms.a: Yes — set the number of rooms and guests in the form and the quote is built on that basis.

transfers.a: Yes — mention it in the notes and the agent will add it to the quote.

VisasPage.title: Visas
VisasPage.description: Know which visa you need, what it costs, how long it takes and which documents are required — before you start.
VisasPage.headline: Where are you travelling?
VisasPage.formTitle: Tell us which visa you need

VisaDetailPage.whatsappMessage: Hello, I'd like to ask about the {visa} visa.
VisaDetailPage.priceNote: Fees include our service charge. Embassies may charge additional fees.

q1.a: The price shown includes our service fee. Some embassies charge government or application-centre fees paid directly; we explain these before you start.

q2.a: The stated time is an estimate in working days and starts once your documents are complete. It varies by embassy and travel season.

q3.q: What if the application is refused?
q3.a: We review your file before submitting to reduce the chance of refusal. The decision rests solely with the embassy, and approval cannot be guaranteed.

VisaDetailPage.applyBody: Fill in the details below and our team will contact you to complete the process and arrange biometrics if required.
VisaDetailPage.noRequirements: We'll share the full document checklist as soon as you start your application.

PackagePlanPage.title: Plan your own trip
PackagePlanPage.description: Tell us where you want to go, for how long, and what you need included — our team will build a custom quote.

how.title: From an idea to a finished itinerary
how.description: You set the destination, the length and the budget; we build the programme around them.

brief.title: Tell us the idea
brief.body: The destination, how many nights, how many are travelling, and the standard of accommodation that suits you.

design.title: We build the programme
design.body: The agent puts together a day-by-day plan with the flights, stays, transfers and tours you asked for.

refine.title: You refine it
refine.body: Change the hotel, add a day, drop a tour — all on WhatsApp, without filling the form in again.

confirm.title: You confirm and we book
confirm.body: When you approve the programme and the final price, we start the bookings.

includes.title: What your programme can include
includes.description: Pick only what you need — the programme is built from what you ask for, not from a fixed list.

flights.title: Flights
flights.body: Return or multi-city, in the cabin you choose.

hotel.title: Accommodation
hotel.body: Three- to five-star hotels, matched to your standard and budget.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.body: Airport pick-up and transfers between cities.

tours.title: Tours
tours.body: Guided day tours, private or in a group.

visa.title: Visa
visa.body: Preparing and following up the visa file for destinations that need one.

insurance.title: Travel insurance
insurance.body: A travel insurance policy covering the length of the trip.

meals.title: Meals
meals.body: Breakfast only or full board, as you prefer.

readymade.title: Or start from a ready-made package
readymade.description: Take one of our programmes as a starting point and change it as you like.

cost.a: Yes. Preparing the programme and the quote carries no fee, and nothing is payable until you approve the booking.

budget.q: What if I do not know my budget yet?
budget.a: Leave the budget field on ‘Any’ and we will send more than one level so you can compare.

time.q: How long does the programme take to prepare?
time.a: It depends on the destination and how many services are involved; the agent tells you the expected turnaround when they contact you.

group.q: Do you arrange trips for groups and large families?
group.a: Yes. Set the number of travellers in the form and note any special arrangements.
